summary: Phase 4 CRM Tour+Travel/Umrah end-to-end frontend testing across Sales, Super Admin, and Accounting roles. All 22 targeted checks passed. Full acceptance chain verified: Customer -> Quotation (auto-approve 3% / PENDING 8%) -> PDF -> Accept -> Convert -> Booking -> Traveler add -> Document upload/verify -> Generate Invoice (Accounting) -> Partial+Full Payment -> Paid status. RBAC visibility for all three roles is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: BookingDetail.jsx: TravelerCard `del` handler calls DELETE /travelers/{id} without a confirmation prompt and silently swallows without a success toast — recommend a confirm() and toast.success for consistency with rest of app.

Quotations.jsx: openPdf uses localStorage token via ?auth= query. Fine, but PDF endpoint should ensure it never logs the token; also consider blob-download to avoid token appearing in browser history/referrer.
Payment attachment file is intentionally not implemented (only attachment_url string). Should be documented in UI hint so accounting knows to paste a URL if required.
BookingDetail.jsx `createInvoice` posts due_date:'' (empty string) — backend should treat empty as null; verify with pydantic validator to avoid future 422s.
Accounting.jsx receivables 'Overdue (90+)' KPI duplicates the 90+ bucket shown below — minor visual redundancy.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 quotations for Budi Santoso (QT-00003 at 3% auto-approved, QT-00004 at 8% pending then admin-approved). QT-00003 converted to booking. Added TEST Traveler Auto with KTP doc (Verified) to first booking.
